research_attempts.query_text: Mary Virginia Walker; NARA OSS index context; CIA Reading Room exact-name domain check; Library of Congress exact-name collection check; exact-name and meaningful variants; OSS, rank, branch, identifier and assignment clues; employer and occupation 1940; obituary, institutional, newspaper, directory and archival searches; indexed Box 813; protected identifiers used only in private official-record comparison
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Unbridged namesakes, snippets, commercial people-finder pages, relatives, unsourced genealogy, postwar-only leads, and sources without an OSS, protected-identifier, rank, unit, or personnel-file bridge were rejected. The two Robert M Walker rows were not merged. Raymond E Walker's material Army-name collision was rejected. The inaccessible NSA Robert N. Walker lead was deferred rather than published from indexed OCR. Historical occupations and student status were not converted into named employers or schools.
research_attempts.research_notes: A 1951 nursing-faculty lead and other modern or genealogical namesakes supplied no OSS, indexed-identifier, or personnel-file bridge and were rejected. Exact-name OSS, employer, occupation, obituary, institutional, newspaper, official-domain, and archival searches were checked as applicable. Grouped CIA Reading Room and Library of Congress discovery checks produced no additional publishable employer source for the cohort. The NARA index page was text-extracted, rendered, and visually checked; official Army bulk data, technical documentation, and code documentation were inspected locally. All cited code pages were also visually checked. No search-result snippet was used as sole final evidence, no paywall or access control was bypassed, and no authenticated NARA Catalog API call was made.
research_attempts.next_action: Review the indexed Box 813 personnel file for corroborating identifiers, the immediate pre-OSS affiliation, and the last civilian employer before wartime service.
